title: feat(i18n,plugin-timeline): retire the unread `timeline.bucket.overdue` key (objectui#11676)
body:
Fixes #11676

Clause-②: no (narrowing)

The card's last piece. Its first half landed as `ce464d9` (PR objectui#11700): a past day on an object-bound timeline is "Earlier". Triage then answered the due-date question with ruling A (comment 6011959066): no timeline says "Overdue", the dead key retires, and the card closes on that. This PR retires `timeline.bucket.overdue` and nothing else: no due-date bucket, no new key, no spec change.

## What changes

- `packages/plugin-timeline/src/useTimelineTranslation.ts`: the `'timeline.bucket.overdue': 'Overdue'` row of `TIMELINE_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS` is gone, with its "kept until the open question decides" comment. A short tombstone comment points at the pin.
- The ten packs (`packages/i18n/src/locales/{en,zh,ja,ko,de,fr,es,pt,ru,ar}.ts`): the `overdue` member of each `timeline: { bucket: { ... } }` block is deleted, one line per pack. The `fields.relativeDate.overdue` plural rows (the date cell's "Overdue 3d") and `slaOverdue` are other families and stay. Each pack's count of lines matching `overdue` drops by exactly one.
- `ObjectTimeline.pastBucket-11676.test.tsx`: the card's own pin gains a `describe` that asserts the key is absent from the defaults row (and that `translateTimelineDefault` answers the bare key) and from every pack's `timeline.bucket`. Non-vacuity: the pack set equals `BUILT_IN_LANGUAGE_CODES`, and `earlier` is present in the table and in every pack. The `fields.relativeDate.overdue` family is pinned as the surviving sibling, because a sweep by leaf name would take it out. The header's "open question" prose now states ruling A. No existing assertion changed.
- `timeline-relative-defaults-retired-7874.test.ts`: no assertion reads the key. Its header cites a positive control measured at `83fe6e741` that used `timeline.bucket.overdue`. That record stays, with a dated note that the key has since retired, so a re-run needs another `ObjectTimeline.tsx` key as its control.
- `packages/plugin-timeline/src/ObjectTimeline.tsx`, comment only (patch round 1, `5068741`): the comment above `dateBucket` said that bringing "Overdue" back through a declared signal "is an open question on objectui#11676". Ruling A answered that, and this PR closes the card, so the sentence now says that triage ruled that no timeline says "Overdue" (ruling A), the bucket is the calendar position alone, and a due-date timeline would be a new card that declares its signals in the spec first. No code line changed.
- Changesets: two. `.changeset/11676-timeline-past-bucket.md` (pending, this card's first half) said "`timeline.bucket.overdue` is kept in every pack". That sentence is corrected in prose only; the front matter is untouched. A new `.changeset/11676-retire-overdue-key.md` (`minor` on `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/plugin-timeline`) declares the removal and the `TranslationKeys` narrowing. The second file is needed because `check-changeset-presence` counts ADDED changesets only (`--diff-filter=A`), so a modified one would not declare this change.

No docs edit: `content/docs/plugins/plugin-timeline.mdx` and the package README already list the buckets as Earlier, Today, Tomorrow, This week, Next week, Later, No date.

## Premise, re-measured on `main` `9ca3cac`

- Readers: `git grep` over tracked `packages/**`, `apps/**`, `scripts/**` and `examples/**`, for the literal key and for assembled spellings (a template literal or concatenation on `timeline.` or `bucket.`). Zero non-test source reads `timeline.bucket.overdue`. The only hits were the defaults row itself and comments in the two pins. Control: the same search finds `timeline.bucket.earlier` read once, by `dateBucket` in `ObjectTimeline.tsx`.
- The pack lines: in all ten packs the deleted line is the first member under `timeline: {` then `bucket: {`, read before the edit. The deletion was anchored on that three-line shape, one hit per pack, checked on disk after writing.

## Public surface: the narrowing, read on built output

`@object-ui/i18n` was built at base (`9ca3cac`, a detached worktree) and at head, and every `dist/**/*.d.ts` was compared. The file set is the same. 11 files differ, all under `dist/locales/`, and every difference is one removed line. `locales/en.d.ts` loses exactly `readonly overdue: "Overdue";` under `timeline.bucket`, so `TranslationKeys = typeof en` loses one member. `zh.d.ts` loses `readonly overdue: "已逾期";`, the other eight packs each lose `overdue: string;`, and `locales/index.d.ts` loses those ten members. `dist/index.d.ts` and the other d.ts files are byte-identical. No additions anywhere, so `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` holds. In `@object-ui/plugin-timeline`, `TIMELINE_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS` keeps its string-to-string `Record` type; head `dist/index.js` carries `timeline.bucket.overdue` 0 times and `timeline.bucket.earlier` 2 times.

Reverse type check against the rebuilt d.ts: a throwaway probe in `packages/plugin-timeline` reading `en.timeline.bucket.overdue` and `TranslationKeys['timeline']['bucket']['overdue']` fails with TS2339 twice (exit 2). The same probe on `earlier` compiles (exit 0). Both probes were deleted after the run; `git status` was empty.

## Tests and gates, at head `e8d7630` (patch round 1 at `5068741`, a comment-only commit, re-ran the plugin-timeline type-check, lint, the card's pin, `packages/plugin-timeline/` (559 passed) and the line-citation, control-byte and changeset gates, all exit 0)

Heavy runs went through `os-verify-lock.sh` with `OS_VERIFY_LOCK_SLOT=issue-11676`. Every exit below was captured before any pipe.

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` on the two pins, `scripts/__tests__/defaults-population-parity-7904.test.ts`, `packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/defaults-maps-mirror-en-pack.test.tsx`, `scripts/__tests__/date-only-zone-pins-10183.test.ts`, `all-locales-key-parity.test.ts` and `en-zh-key-parity.test.ts`: at base `Test Files 7 passed (7)`, `Tests 102 passed (102)`; at head `Test Files 7 passed (7)`, `Tests 105 passed (105)`, the 3 new pins added. Exit 0 both.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-timeline/`: `Test Files 45 passed (45)`, `Tests 559 passed | 37 skipped (596)`, exit 0. The skipped cases include the zone cases the 10183 driver runs.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/i18n/`: `Test Files 80 passed (80)`, `Tests 1304 passed | 13 skipped (1317)`, exit 0.
- `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/plugin-timeline^...' build`, then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-timeline build`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check`, `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-timeline type-check`: exit 0, both script names echoed. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists both edited pins, and it resolves `@object-ui/i18n/locales` to the rebuilt `dist/locales/index.d.ts`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n lint`, `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-timeline lint`: exit 0. As `eslint . --format json`: 112 and 51 files, 0 errors. The 13 changed TS files are all in those sets, with 0 errors and 0 warnings. Root `pnpm lint` is `turbo run lint`, the same per-package `eslint .`, so these two runs are its narrowing to the packages this diff touches. `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions` / `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and this diff cannot change a verdict in another package. The full run is CI's.
- `pnpm check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`: exit 0 before and after. Readings moved as predicted. Keys: the factory-defaults rows compared went from 969 to 968, all matching. Drift: "0 key(s) added, 1 removed". Dead keys: en pack keys from 3274 to 3273, candidates from 346 to 345, and the `timeline.bucket` namespace (1 needs-review, `timeline.bucket.overdue`) is gone from the report.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (`VERDICT ... 0 new citation(s)`), `check:control-bytes`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:published-dist`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-overwrite.mjs`: exit 0, report-only. It reports the edit to `.changeset/11676-timeline-past-bucket.md` as its case 2, a deliberate prose correction; the declared packages are unchanged. `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-presence` ("1 changeset(s) added"), `check-changeset-fixed`: exit 0.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:eager-locale-catalogues` needs a full console build. This diff removes one key and adds no catalogue to any eager closure. Left to CI.

## Ablation: one key back in one pack

On the committed tree, `node /home/user/objectstack/scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` put `overdue: '已逾期',` back under `timeline.bucket` in `zh.ts` only. It wrapped a vitest run of the card's pin, `all-locales-key-parity.test.ts` and `en-zh-key-parity.test.ts`. The prediction was 3 red: the new "no pack carries it" pin, "zh defines no key that en lacks", and "has no zh key absent from en". Observed: `Test Files 3 failed (3)`, `Tests 3 failed | 52 passed (55)`, exactly those three. The mutation landed on disk: anchor x1 to x0, replacement x0 to x1, blob `c683b85f` to `753b9732`, and the planted line counted 1 during the run. Restore: blob `c683b85f` equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` is empty, and `git status` is clean. The run read packs from source (the vitest alias maps `@object-ui/i18n` to `packages/i18n/src`), so no rebuild was involved.

The first attempt was a refused no-op. Its anchor, the `earlier` line, also occurs inside the planted text, so the anchor count could not drop. The tool refused before running anything and proved the restore. The second attempt used the two-line `bucket: {` plus `earlier` anchor.

## Acceptance notes

- One local step broke the shared-box discipline: `pnpm check:published-dist` builds every published package (a 43-task turbo build, about 5 minutes) and ran outside the verify lock. It finished green and left the worktree clean.
